note: The harbour set in kit/catalog/assets/harbour/: models made by export_harbour.gd, sounds by harbour.py sounds, all measured by harbour.py record. Never edit by hand.

models.name: rowboat
models.description: A small clinker-built wooden rowboat, 3.8 m long, its top strake painted blue, with three thwarts, floor boards, iron rowlocks, two oars resting along the seats and the painter coiled in the bow. The origin is the waterline: place it at the water's height.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_harbour.gd in the city's low-poly painted look (the city has no harbour: its water is the mill pond, the canals and the fountains)

models.name: fishing boat
models.description: A 6.8 m decked wooden fishing boat, green above the waterline, with a short mast and its tanned sail furled on the boom, a small cream cuddy forward, a tiller aft, two lobster pots, a fish box, a coil of rope and fenders over the side. The origin is the waterline: place it at the water's height, beside a quay.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_harbour.gd in the city's low-poly painted look (the city has no harbour: its water is the mill pond, the canals and the fountains)

models.name: mooring bollard
models.description: A cast-iron mooring bollard, dark iron-grey and rust-streaked, 0.6 m tall on a granite pad, with a rope made fast round its neck and trailing to the water. Line a quay with them, 4-6 m apart.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_harbour.gd in the city's low-poly painted look (the city has no harbour: its water is the mill pond, the canals and the fountains)

models.name: harbour bell
models.description: A bronze harbour bell 0.5 m across hung in a timber frame 2.7 m tall on a stone plinth, with a pull rope; it swings on its headstock when rung. Play its ring clip with the bell sound from a script when the bell is rung.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_harbour.gd in the city's low-poly painted look (the city has no harbour: its water is the mill pond, the canals and the fountains)

models.name: pile of fishing net
models.description: A heap of brown fishing net, 2.2 x 1.7 m, in three folds with a string of cork floats round its edge, two glass floats on top and a coil of rope beside it; lay it on a quay, a deck or beside a net shed.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_harbour.gd in the city's low-poly painted look (the city has no harbour: its water is the mill pond, the canals and the fountains)

models.name: fishmonger's slab
models.description: A fishmonger's slab 2.2 m long on two oak trestles: a board tilted toward the buyer and covered in ice with three rows of silver herring, two posts behind it with a rail and three fish hung by the tail from it, a chalk price slate on the front and a chopping block at one end. Front (the buyer's side) is -Z. Line a fish hall with them, 3-4 m apart, or set one on a quay.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_harbour.gd in the city's low-poly painted look (the city has no harbour: its water is the mill pond, the canals and the fountains)

models.name: stack of fish crates
models.description: Three open wooden fish crates, 0.7 x 0.45 x 0.26 m each, two side by side and one across them, each packed with herring on ice. Stack a few by a fish hall's stalls, on a quay beside a boat or on a cart.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_harbour.gd in the city's low-poly painted look (the city has no harbour: its water is the mill pond, the canals and the fountains)

models.name: net hung to dry
models.description: A brown fishing net hung to dry over a rack 2.6 m long: two A-frame ends and a pole 2.1 m up, the net falling to about half a metre above the floor on both sides and sagging between the ends, with cork floats along its hems. Stand it in a fish hall or a net shed, or along a quay.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_harbour.gd in the city's low-poly painted look (the city has no harbour: its water is the mill pond, the canals and the fountains)

models.name: herring gull
models.description: An adult herring gull 0.58 m long: white with a pale grey back, black wing tips with white mirrors, a yellow bill with its red spot and pink legs. It stands on a bollard, a roof or a quay looking about (clip perch; the file's rest pose is the same, wings folded); its fly clip beats the wings with the legs tucked, for a gull a script moves through the air (entity_move_to, see kit/catalog/README.md).
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_harbour.gd in the city's low-poly painted look (the city has no harbour: its water is the mill pond, the canals and the fountains)

models.name: sea waves (ambient loop)
models.description: Waves washing against a harbour wall: a low swell of surf with a hiss as each wave breaks, about two waves every ten seconds. 16 s, mono, loops seamlessly; the bed under a harbour or a beach.
models.cite: synthesised for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/harbour.py sounds (seeded noise and partials, no recording)

models.name: harbour bell strike
models.description: One strike of a bronze bell (G4 with its hum, tierce and nominal partials), ringing out over about five seconds. Mono; play it at the bell's position, once, from a quest's play or a script.
models.cite: synthesised for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/harbour.py sounds (seeded noise and partials, no recording)

models.name: gull calls
models.description: A herring gull calling: two long mewing cries and a run of short laughing kyow-kyow notes, 3.6 s, mono. Loop it at a position on a roof or the quay, or play it now and then from a script.
models.cite: synthesised for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/harbour.py sounds (seeded noise and partials, no recording)
